facts.fact: Tech Rek reports that the national population registry and secure documents agency runs its own information system, including the Houwiyeti app and citizen reception centres, and took it offline for a day for preventive maintenance.

Tech Rek reports that the agency carried out and announced the preventive maintenance of its information system, and that periodic maintenance was generally done on Saturdays, with no foreign supplier named.

systems.owner: Agence nationale du registre des populations et des titres sécurisés
